assessment_areas.json.source: Per-bank FDIC/OCC CRA Performance Evaluation PDFs (public), hand-entered
assessment_areas.json.note: Each bank entry carries verified:false until Matthew re-reads its PE. The generator refuses --send for unverified banks.

funnel_assumptions.json.source: T3 funnel research 2026-08-22 (docs/strategy/cra-pilot-research-2026-08-22.md): WordStream 2025 CPC benchmarks, SuperAds nonprofit Meta CPC, USDA FNS FY2024 benefit averages, Code for America / mRelief published funnel context
funnel_assumptions.json.note: Mid-funnel rates (session->check->app) have NO published benchmark; measuring them is the pilot's stated learning goal.

county_metrics.csv.derived_from: ca-snap-gap LightGBM model over 2023 ACS 1-Year PUMS (CV AUC 0.80), PUMA->county tract-weighted crosswalk
county_metrics.csv.note: 2023 ACS 1-YEAR, not 5-year. Known upward biases (gross-income proxy; ACS benefit under-reporting) are disclosed in every generated PDF.
